newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ed to restore Pilgrim nuke late March.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ed to restore Pilgrim nuke late March.

text.p: Boston Edison Co said Tuesday it plans to restore its 670 megawatt Pilgrim 1 nuclear power plant late March after shutting the plant for refueling and maintenance.
The plant, in Plymouth, Mass., was taken off line at 0100 EST Saturday, an onsite spokeswoman said.
Nuclear Regulatory Commission said in Tuesday's daily status report that the facility would start up April 9.
Boston Edison Co is the operator and sole owner of Pilgrim 1, which accounts for a third of its generating capacity.
